rows.falsifier: Demonstration that the observed history-dependent behavior in flow-controlled networks is fully explainable by simple slow-relaxation kinetics of a single variable, without non-linear autocatalytic feedback.
rows.reason: Experimental evidence [peer-756d5cf5076d5b4a00b1070b] shows programmed history-dependent responses in flow-controlled trypsin-catalyzed systems. [peer-0592c13110957d2468eeda39] provides the algebraic criteria for the subnetwork structures necessary for this persistence.
rows.statement: Flow-controlled autocatalytic reaction networks can exhibit history-dependent responses that function as chemical memory, distinct from simple state hysteresis.
